courses.notes: 9-hole par-3 pitch-and-putt in Butler Park downtown (par 27 = 9 par-3 holes); real grass greens plus a putting area on about 8 acres. Hand-built by Douglas and Winston Kinser and opened June 1, 1950. Run by Pecan Grove Golf Partners (incl. New Waterloo, Criquet, Yeti); Golf ATX lists it under concessions. Open daily 8a-8p, with occasional closures for leagues and events. Typical round under 2 hours. Yardage not published. short_game_area=true refers to the dedicated putting area. Architects listed are the founders who built it by hand.

Phone is the Golf ATX office line given on the course page. short_game_area=false means only a putting green is listed.

courses.notes: 'Muny'. Opened 1924 by the Lions Club as a 9-hole course on UT's Brackenridge Tract, later expanded to 18; lease transferred to the City in 1936. On the National Register of Historic Places; one of the first courses in the South to desegregate (before Brown v. Board, 1954); hosts the Firecracker Open. Land is owned by UT and leased to the City; news reports say it has operated under short-term lease extensions since 2019 while the Muny Conservancy fundraises for permanent preservation, so long-term future not secured. Scorecard: par 71, Blue 5,825 yd (69.8/123). Practice: driving range (irons only) + putting greens; range closes Mondays 1 pm. Closed every 3rd Monday for maintenance; closed for overseeding Oct 6. Architect not stated on official sources.

courses.name: The Bandit Golf Club

courses.notes: Foresight Golf owned/managed; open to public play. Black tees 6,909 yd, 73.7/134 per official scorecard. Toptracer range; 12,000 sq ft practice green. Near Lake McQueeney (Guadalupe County side of New Braunfels). Coordinates from OSM.

courses.name: Legends Golf Course & Villas (Legends on Lake LBJ)

green_fee.notes: No rate card published; rates shown only inside the Club Prophet (cps.golf) booking engine. Golf included with villa/cabin stay-and-play.

courses.notes: Official site calls it a public course with on-site villas/cabins. Back-tee yardage is the sum of the 18 gold-tee hole yardages on the official hole-by-hole guide (7,159). Booking window not stated (FAQ says book as early as possible). Opening year not on official site.

courses.name: Starcke Park Golf Course

green_fee.notes: City rates: adult weekday $33, weekend/holiday $37; senior 60+ weekday $26; military weekday $26; twilight after 2pm $22; 9 holes $22; junior $12 / $13.50 weekend. Green fees only - carts extra ($17/18 holes, $12/9).

courses.notes: City of Seguin course (a.k.a. Max Starcke Park Golf Course) on the Guadalupe River; reopened May 2026 after a 1+ year renovation (new larger Paspalum greens, renovated/expanded practice range, re-designed holes). City says it was established 1938 with Bredemus and Hugman among the designers. Layout page lists Black 6,784 yd par 72; may or may not reflect post-renovation yardages. Tee times required daily. Coordinates from OSM.

courses.name: Stonetree Golf Club

green_fee.notes: Posted rates: 18 holes weekday $32.50 walking / $50.00 with cart; weekend $43.00 / $60.50; twilight (2-4pm) $22.50-$42.50; super twilight (4pm-close) $18.00-$36.00; senior $24.00-$54.50; junior $16.50-$20.00. Active-duty military $5 off. Site says lowest rates are online.

courses.notes: Borderline distance (Killeen, Bell County, roughly 70 miles; about 1h15-1h30 drive). Managed by Troon; annual passes priced for residents vs non-residents. Official site: built 1970 by Jay Riviere, renovated 2005 by Lee Singletary; booking-engine description says opened 1972 (year left null due to conflict). Par 72 and 6,693 yds from the official TeeItUp booking engine description. Walking inferred from published green-fee-only (no cart) rates. Double-ended range, pitching green, practice bunker, putting green. Pace limit 4.5 hours.

courses.name: Frisch Auf! Valley Country Club

green_fee.notes: Club golf page: 18 holes $40 + tax Tue-Thu, $60 + tax Fri-Sun & holidays; 9 holes $26 Tue-Thu, $30 Fri-Sun. Carts $26/18, $16/9 (share $13/golfer). A Sept 2025 chamber spotlight listed lower non-member rates ($35/18), so the club page is treated as current.

courses.notes: Member club whose 9-hole course accepts public green-fee play (phone reservations at 979-968-6113; office 979-968-3965). Closed Mondays. Est. 1966 per La Grange chamber member spotlight. About 75-90 min drive from Austin - at the edge of the scope. Coordinates from OSM.

courses.name: Hancock Park Golf Course

green_fee.notes: Official fees (tax incl.): weekday green $32, with half cart $52; weekend green $37, with half cart $57; senior/military $29-$54; 9 holes $20 ($30 w/ half cart).

courses.notes: City of Lampasas municipal course (lampasas.org golf page redirects here). Opened 1945 as nine holes, expanded to 18 in 1996. Site says 'just 6,000 yards from the championship tees' (approximate, so yardage left null). Tee times by phone; required weekends/holidays. ~60 miles NW of Austin (borderline distance).

courses.name: Sammons Golf Course

green_fee.notes: City of Temple daily rates (updated from 1 June 2026): weekday 18 holes $23 walking / $44 with cart; weekend $28 / $49; senior/military weekday $18 / $39; 9 holes $18-$23 walking, $31-$36 with cart. The official TeeItUp engine showed $31-$49 for 18 holes with cart on 5-6 Oct 2026.

courses.notes: Borderline distance (Temple, Bell County, roughly 65-70 miles north of downtown Austin via I-35). Municipal course open to public year-round with range, pitching/chipping area and putting green. Opened December 1922 as the 9-hole Lake Polk Golf and Country Club; second nine added in the 1950s; redesigned in the mid-1980s under former mayor John F. Sammons Jr. (no golf architect named). Black tees 6,597 yds (72.5/137), par 72.

courses.name: Lady Bird Johnson Golf Course

courses.notes: City of Fredericksburg municipal course in Lady Bird Johnson Memorial Park, managed by Touchstone Golf. Opened 1969 as 9 holes ('Live Oak'), 18 holes from 1991, renovated 2012. Black tees 6,686 (72.1/127). Borderline distance (~80 mi from Austin).

courses.name: Lighthouse Country Club (formerly Packsaddle)

green_fee.notes: Site defers to foreUP booking engine. Public-class 18-hole riding prices returned by engine on read date: Wed 7 Oct 2026 $36.71-$55.53; Sat 10 Oct 2026 $42.36-$65.89 (vary by time of day). 9-hole and senior rates also offered.

courses.notes: This is the Kingsland 'Packsaddle' course (renamed after 2011 purchase). Course page: championship tees 6,558 yds; posted scorecard image shows par 71 and 6,485 from back tees. Double-ended range, 10,000 sq ft putting green, chipping green. Coordinates not found in OSM/Nominatim.

Coordinates not found in OSM/Nominatim.

courses.notes: Public 9-hole course in the Blue Lake area of Horseshoe Bay (separate from Horseshoe Bay Resort). Par and yardage not stated on official site. Coordinates not found in OSM/Nominatim.
